note: Regulatory milestones for the EU Digital Product Passport. Dates drive the live countdowns on /digital-product-passport, so every entry needs a real ISO date and a source anyone can check. Entries marked indicative use the European Commission's indicative dates and are estimates, not adopted law. Maintained by the 'DPP regulatory watch' Routine; see docs/strategy/persuasion-doctrine.md for the copy rules.

milestones.label: EU DPP registry rules adopted
milestones.detail: The Commission adopted Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 on the DPP registry on 16 July 2026.
milestones.badge: EU DPP registry rules adopted: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778

milestones.label: LMT, EV and industrial (>2 kWh) batteries
milestones.detail: Mandatory passport for LMT, EV and industrial (>2 kWh) batteries. Carbon footprint, recycled content and due diligence fields apply later, on their own dates (Commission FAQ Q7.2).

milestones.label: Construction Products (CPR 2024/3110)
milestones.detail: Indicative: Commission delegated act for construction materials under the Construction Products Regulation (EU) 2024/3110 expected Q2 2027. Estimate, not adopted law.

milestones.label: Furniture (indicative)
milestones.detail: Indicative: ESPR delegated act for furniture expected in 2028. Estimate, not adopted law.

milestones.label: Textiles, Apparel & Footwear (indicative)
milestones.detail: Estimate: delegated act indicative Q3-Q4 2027, with DPP rules applying at least 18 months later: 2029 at the earliest (estimate). Fibre composition, recycled content, country of origin and care instructions.

milestones.label: Electronics & ICT Products (indicative)
milestones.detail: Estimate: ICT delegated act indicative 2029, with DPP rules applying at least 18 months later (around 2030-31).
